notes.text: The categorical branch of the preprocessing pipeline carries no scaler, so one-hot columns hold at most 0.25 variance against 1.0 for standardised numeric columns. Measured one-hot share of total variance: With TTL shortcut: 0.0405, Without TTL shortcut: 0.0427. PCA is numeric-dominated by construction; a numeric-heavy PC1 is expected and is not evidence that the categorical features are uninformative.

Silhouette is computed on a stratified subsample of at most 10,000 rows, stratified by attack_cat with a per-class floor of 50, seed 42. K-Means itself is fitted on the full cleaned training partition; only the metric is sampled. The value is an estimate, and the floor makes the sample class-rebalanced rather than population-representative.
The DBSCAN noise fraction, cluster count and cluster sizes are properties of that same subsample. They are not claims about the full cleaned training partition.

Local density scales with row count. An eps calibrated on a 10,000-row sample is too large for the full partition and must not be lifted into another notebook. Chord rule degenerated to a fallback for: none.

attack_cat is used for stratification, colouring and post-hoc profiling only. It never enters a feature matrix and is never a fitting target. No external cluster-validation metric (adjusted Rand index, normalised mutual information) is computed here; those are reserved for notebook 2.

Removing sttl and ct_state_ttl changed the maximum VIF: False (with_ttl=inf, without_ttl=inf). Changed the 90%-variance component count: False (with_ttl=12, without_ttl=12). Changed the selected k: False (with_ttl=10, without_ttl=10). Changed the number of distinct clusters in the composition table: False.
